name: GET /api/admin/metrics/revenue - Revenue and billing health
description: Paid, failed and refunded totals over the trailing 30 days, plus counts of past-due accounts and manual plan overrides. Amounts are in minor units (cents) to avoid floating-point rounding. Aggregated with SQL FILTER rather than by fetching payment rows. Read-only, so no step-up elevation required.

errorCases.when: The caller is authenticated but is not a platform_admin (a tenant-level admin is refused here)

errorCases.message: Platform administrator access has been revoked
errorCases.when: The admin's own access_status is suspended or revoked
